title: Bound changed BIT terminal decoders and fresh helper returns
body:
All 4,125,628 nonbridge two-packet omissions fail a necessary terminal-bank test, even granting new decoders at all 138 final charts. Every one of 129 one-bank rank-one deficits fails every affordable last receipt, independently checked against 12,569 donor banks. The early supplement also excludes all nine retained terminal carriers without paid descendants and 464 affordable donor-bank tests. Across 112 projected main-port releases, all 922 feasible fresh-helper choices have negative signed changes and none has grade eight.

## Task and overlap

The earlier #7978 `dd529bbb031cf87b424d43841a88a009773fa24b` fixes the terminal rows, and #7953 fixes exterior stock for chart-1 sink matching. This test changes all terminal decoders and uses the actual post-puncture stock. The new-helper part changes one bank’s selected outgoing rows without adding a paid MOVE. The archive separates the precise scopes. The scoped task is the #7852 follow-up at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, based on `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` and #7830 `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. The archive gives exact source identities and complete assumptions.

## Validation

From a fresh extraction run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and `python3 -B verify.py`. The merged cold replay passed in 113.88 seconds with 117,392 KiB peak. The independent run matches all first-bank pairs, directly checks the 129 late seeds and 26,634 bank comparisons, and rejects damaged source and seed controls. The producer replays three literal controls in both orientations and their complete 36/48-call bins. The early raw-word audit detects the false pass caused by reintroducing an omitted unpunctured value.

## Open next questions

A newly funded candidate needs changed surviving paid sender equations or other genuinely new routes, then independent source, erasure, precision, stock and finite outer application checks. The proof covers one last receipt and the named no-descendant early-carrier scope.
